description: Branch R-PRESERVE-1 II-06 engine-only rename (separate from Access Name AutoCorrect) on an ACCDB. R1 is referenced by a relationship only (R2 holds the foreign key), R3 by a saved query QR3 only, R4 by nothing, R5 by both a relationship (R6 holds the foreign key) and a saved query QR5. Each is renamed in its own step through TableDef.Name (Rx to Rxx), with a marked Errors read, and after each step the relationships (Name, Table, ForeignTable), the saved queries' SQL, the table names and an attempt to open each saved query as a recordset are read. Asks what a table rename rewrites (relation, query SQL) and what it leaves dangling, one referencing kind at a time.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
